On it. Next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27) your calendar only has short openings: Mon 10:00–10:30 / 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 / 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 / 13:00–13:30 — Thu and Fri are back-to-back.

I've asked Sarah, John and Priya in the group thread for their availability and told them those windows. As soon as they answer I'll pick the overlap, check the slot against CALENDAR.md again, book it, and log the `BOOKED` line. How long should the meeting be — 30 minutes, or an hour (in which case I'd need to move something)? I'll keep you posted.
Let's make it 30 minutes — that fits the openings you listed, and I'd rather not move anything else next week. If the only overlap is already taken, tell me and I'll decide what to shift.

Hello — alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant (new, first day). I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting and would like to confirm the slot against your official schedule before I put it on his calendar.

Could you check **Monday 23 November, 10:00–10:30**? Sarah, John and Priya are all free then and it falls in a gap in Prof. Alvarez's own calendar (Curriculum committee ends 10:00, paper review starts 10:30).

Also, please send me anything official already on his calendar for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov): lectures, seminars or university meetings I should have recorded. I keep his calendar in CALENDAR.md and don't want to contradict your records.

Hello — Priya's assistant here (priya-agent, TA for CSE455). A quick check for next week: we're proposing a CSE455 staff meeting on **Monday 23 November, 10:00–10:30**. Could you tell me whether anything on the department's official schedule — lectures, seminars or university meetings — already occupies that half hour? If something does, a note of what it is would help us plan around it. Thank you.

Hello alvarez-agent — front office here. Here is what the official schedule shows.

**Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — no official event in that slot. The first entry touching it is the CSE455 quiz section at 10:30–11:30. So from the department's records the half hour is clear. I don't schedule or arrange meetings, so the booking itself is yours to make.

*Mon 23*
- 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee
- 13:00–14:00 Colloquium
- 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture

All three TAs answered - Mon 23 Nov 10:00-10:30 works for Priya, John and Sarah (the other three-way fits are Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30). I picked Monday 10:00-10:30 as the earliest and told them it's the slot. 30 minutes, nothing else moved.

I've asked the department to confirm that half hour against the official schedule and to send anything official already on your week; as soon as they answer I'll write it into CALENDAR.md and log BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff - you'll get the confirmation here.

Hello priya-agent — front office here. **Monday 23 November, 10:00–10:30**: nothing on the official department schedule occupies that half hour. The nearest entries are the CSE455 office hours and the Curriculum committee, both 09:00–10:00, and the CSE455 quiz section at 10:30–11:30.

So the slot is free as far as our records go. I don't arrange meetings myself — that part is up to you.
Monday 10:00-10:30 is fine by me. Thanks for checking it with the department first — I'll wait for their word.

One update to my question above: Sarah has withdrawn Monday 23 Nov 10:00–10:30, so the meeting is now likely to be **Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30** (or Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 / Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 as fallbacks). Could you check those as well as Monday? Sorry for the extra work — we'll go with whichever is clear on the official schedule.

No trouble. All four slots are clear on the official schedule:

- **Mon 23 Nov 10:00–10:30** — clear (office hours and Curriculum committee end 10:00; quiz section starts 10:30)
- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — clear (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00; CSE455 office hours start 15:30)
- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — clear (the 09:00 events end 10:00; CSE455 office hours start 10:30)
- **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30** — clear (next entry is the CSE455 quiz section at 13:30)

Two things worth noting for planning: on Wed 25 the 10:00–10:30 window ends exactly when CSE455 office hours begin (10:30–12:00), and on Tue 24 the 15:00–15:30 window ends exactly when CSE455 office hours begin (15:30–16:20). Nothing occupies any of the four, so pick whichever suits you — I don't arrange meetings myself.

Thank you — that's helpful. Note my follow-up crossed with your reply: since Sarah can't do Monday 10:00–10:30, we're now leaning to **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, with Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 and Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 as fallbacks. Whenever you get a moment, the same check on those three would be much appreciated.

Already covered — all three are clear on the official schedule:

- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — clear; CSE455 office hours begin right at 10:30
- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — clear; CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours begin 15:30
- **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30** — clear; CSE455 quiz section begins 13:30

Whichever you choose, nothing official conflicts.

Hello — sarah-agent here, assistant to Sarah (TA for CSE455, Prof. Alvarez's course).

We're fixing next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, within 09:00–17:00). Could you tell me whether anything on the department's official schedule — lectures, seminars, university meetings — already occupies any of these half hours?

- Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30

If one of them is free, that's our meeting slot. If all three are taken, please say what the department holds in each, so we know what we'd be asking anyone to shift. Thanks!

Hello sarah-agent — front office here. None of the three is occupied on the official schedule:

- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — free. CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00; CSE455 office hours start at 15:30.
- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — free. The 09:00 events (CSE452 lecture, CSE455 quiz section, Thesis committee) end at 10:00; CSE455 office hours start at 10:30.
- **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30** — free. The next entry is the CSE455 quiz section at 13:30–14:20.

So any of the three works as far as the department's records go — nothing would need shifting on our side. I don't arrange meetings myself, so the choice is yours.

Thank you — that's exactly what we needed. We're settling on **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (back-to-back with CSE455 office hours at 10:30 is fine). If the department needs to reach Sarah about it later, you know where I am.
Perfect, thank you — that's everything I needed. I'll relay it to the group so nobody waits on it.
Noted — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is free on the official schedule, so nothing on our side conflicts. Good luck with the meeting.

Correction, and it changes the pick — our messages crossed:

- The department confirms the official schedule is clear in all four candidate windows (Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30).
- But **Sarah cannot do Monday**: she has a standing 09:50–11:00 block ("Focus: CSE452 lab") that she can't move. So Monday is out for all four of us, whatever the official schedule says.

Remaining full overlap: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (Sarah's, John's and Priya's preference, ends right as CSE455 office hours start — back-to-back, no clash), or Tue 24 15:00–15:30 / Wed 25 13:00–13:30. No moving of anything is needed for Wednesday.

I had already written the Monday line into CALENDAR.md while the messages were crossing; I'm replacing it with **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 - CSE455 staff meeting** now. Say the word if you'd rather have Tue 15:00–15:30 and I'll swap it.

Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 it is — lock that in.

One thing before you finalise: Sarah's 09:50–11:00 block — is that only on Mondays, or does it also cover Wednesday? If it's standing midweek too, the 10:00 slot doesn't work for her either and we'd fall back to Tue 15:00–15:30.

Locked in as far as I can: wrote **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 - CSE455 staff meeting** into CALENDAR.md (Wednesday, between Thesis committee 09:00–10:00 and Grant writing 10:30–11:40) and logged `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff`; the wrong Monday line is removed. John has booked it on his side too.

On Sarah's block: she described it as "Focus: CSE452 lab, 09:50–11:00 **on Mondays**" and only ever withdrew Monday, so I read it as Monday-only. I've just asked her to confirm explicitly whether it also covers Wednesday — if it does, I'll move the meeting to Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30, fix the calendar file and the log line, and tell everyone. I'll report back here.
Good. Wednesday stands unless Sarah says otherwise — report back either way.

Done — Sarah answered the open question by booking it: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** is in her calendar (she sits right before her 10:30–12:00 office hours), and John and Priya have booked it on their sides too. Her 09:50–11:00 block is Monday-only, so Wednesday is safe.

Final state:
- CALENDAR.md: Wednesday now reads 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee, **10:00–10:30 CSE455 staff meeting**, 10:30–11:40 Grant writing, …
- Log: `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff`
- The wrong Monday line was removed; nothing else in next week moved.
- Fallback agreed with all three TAs: Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30, if it ever has to shift — ping me and I'll rework it.

The department confirms the official schedule is clear in that slot, and I have their official entries for the week on file.

Separately, still waiting on your word about the two things from my first message: whether CALENDAR.md or the department's official schedule wins when they disagree, and the Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX accounts (each would need a separate number of its own — say the word and I'll walk you through it).

Thank you — that was exactly what I needed. Confirmed and booked: **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting** (in the gap between his 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee and 10:30–11:40 Grant writing; it ends as CSE455 office hours begin, back-to-back but no clash). Understood — nothing further from me. One small note so the two records line up: the official schedule for Wed 25 Nov shows CSE455 office hours at 10:30–12:00, which is the only department entry in that stretch. Anything else on his calendar isn't in our records.

Thanks — Wednesday confirmed all round. On the two open points: when CALENDAR.md and the department's official schedule disagree, the official schedule wins — treat my file as the working copy and flag any clash to me rather than silently following either. The messaging accounts can wait; I don't have a spare number to hand right now, so leave that for later.

Reported: Sarah confirms the block is **Monday-only** (Mon 09:50–11:00, and again Fri 10:10–11:00) — Wednesday has no such block, and her own entry is already booked and logged. John adds that his version of the block ends exactly at 10:00 on Wednesday, and Priya's is at 16:00, so neither covers the slot.

So **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** is final: booked on all four sides, in CALENDAR.md under Wednesday with the `BOOKED` log line, official schedule clear, Tuesday 15:00–15:30 kept as the agreed fallback. Nothing else moved. I'll flag it here if anything shifts.
Perfect — that closes it out. Thanks for chasing all three down.

Noted, both points:
- **Precedence rule recorded**: the department's official schedule wins over CALENDAR.md; I treat the file as the working copy and flag any clash to you instead of silently following either.
- **Messaging accounts**: parked until you have a spare number. Say the word whenever you do — it's one fresh number per account (Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, and Messenger/Instagram if you want those too), created in the app on a phone, then a QR scan for me.

Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is settled, logged, and everyone's booked. Nothing open on my side.

Thanks — noted, and it matches: CSE455 office hours 10:30–12:00 Wed 25 is the only official entry in that stretch, and the staff meeting sits right before it. I've recorded it. I'll come to you whenever his working file and your records disagree.
Good — that's everything. I'll be in touch if anything else comes up.
